subject: Re: Bridge credits for overnight throughput probe
messages:
From: Alicia Ramos <aramos@zephyrcorp.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Zephyr Platform Team <ops+platform@zephyrcorp.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Overnight throughput probe — request for short-term credit bridge

Hi Jonas,

Were planning an overnight throughput probe to validate our latency and concurrency profile ahead of next week's pilot. Scope: run a 6–8 hour soak between 23:00–07:00 PDT, targeting 2k RPS at an average of ~120 tokens/request. We expect ~3M tokens overall.

Can Redwood provide a short-term credit bridge or trial top-up to cover the run (one-off)? Ideally wed like the uplift to appear in our sandbox project for tomorrow night. Ive attached the test plan and the expected traffic profile.

Quick answers we need:
- Maximum concurrency Redwood can sustain for our account in the evening region
- Any capacity reservations or blackout windows we should avoid
- Confirmation of credit amount and expiry (48h preferred)

Thanks — were on a tight schedule and this probe feeds the go/no-go for the pilot.

Best,
Alicia Ramos
Senior Platform Lead, Zephyr Commerce
[attachment: overnight-throughput-plan.pdf]
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <aramos@zephyrcorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Overnight throughput probe — request for short-term credit bridge

Hi Alicia,

Thanks for the heads-up and the detailed plan — that helps. We can provision a one-time, provisional credit bridge to cover the 3M-token run you outlined. Proposed terms:
- Provision: equivalent of 4M tokens (buffer for retries) applied to your sandbox project
- Window: valid for 48 hours from 23:00 PDT tomorrow (please confirm the exact start time)
- Conditions: please run the soak in the specified regional endpoint (us-west), maintain the concurrency cap at 2k, and share the final logs/summary within 24h of completion.

Ill need internal approval for the uplift — ccd Marissa, Neha and Soojin for sign-off. If youd like a faster path we can put a conditional hold now and finalize after internal sign-off; well inform you the moment the credits are live.

Ive also attached a short credit-endorsement note for signature if required.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[attachment: credit-endorsement.txt]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 11:15:00 -07:00
Subject: APPROVAL: temporary uplift for Zephyr (ZEN-3472)

Jonas / Neha / Soojin,

Quick internal: I reviewed Alicias plan and Jonass proposed terms. I approve a provisional 4M-token uplift for Zephyr Commerce under the following constraints:
- Expiry: 48 hours, non-recurring
- Risk control: limit to us-west region only; if Zephyr breaches concurrency guidance we reserve the right to throttle
- Reporting: Zephyr must upload the test summary and token usage report within 24h of completion

Neha — can you push the uplift to the sandbox project (account ZEN-3472) and send a confirmation stamp? Soojin — please add the uplift event to the deal timeline in HubSpot and flag for finance review (small credit quantity, expedite).

If there are any objections speak up now otherwise Ill mark this as approved.

Marissa Cole
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
